name: com.imagetopes/imagetopes
title: ImageToPES Embroidery Digitizer & Binary Inspector
description: Convert PNG/JPG/SVG artwork to Brother .PES & Tajima .DST embroidery files or inspect binaries.

tools.name: inspect_embroidery_binary
tools.description: Decode and verify a Brother .PES (#PES0001) or Tajima .DST (512-byte header) binary file for free.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded Brother .PES or Tajima .DST binary file (max 5 MB).

fileName.description: Original filename with .pes or .dst extension (default: design.pes).

tools.name: convert_image_to_pes
tools.description: Compile SVG or raster PNG/JPG artwork into 5 embroidery machine formats (.PES, .DST, .JEF, .EXP, .VP3) with 3D thread preview and worksheet.

svgText.description: Raw SVG markup to digitize into embroidery stitches.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG image (max 5 MB).

hoop.description: Target hoop size in mm (e.g. 100 for 4x4, 130 for 5x7, 160 for 6x10).

fabric.description: Fabric density and underlay preset (default: woven).
